text: Hi, my name is Beatriz Costa and I have a problem with order MG-20481937.
The order had two books. Persuasion arrived with water damage on the cover.
The other parcel had the wrong book: I ordered Middlemarch and got Mansfield Park.
Please write to me by email only. I cannot take phone calls at work.
For Persuasion I would like a replacement, not a refund.
For Middlemarch I want my money back. I bought it somewhere else in the meantime.
I have photographs of the damaged cover next to the box. Where do I send them?
Also, I am moving house next week, so the replacement should go to Rua das Flores 120, Curitiba.
Do I need to send the damaged copy back to you?
How do I send back Mansfield Park?
How long will the refund for Middlemarch take?
Sorry, what was my order number again? I need it for my notes.
